I haven’t been the biggest fan of westerns, but maybe I was looking in the wrong places! I watched this as a kid and wanted to come back to it because I remember loving it so much. It started off a little slow, but it picked up very quickly. I can’t lie. I had to watch this in three parts so my rating might be a little bit biased this time. But something that I really loved about this movie was how gritty the animation was. I feel like sometimes you see animation movies now and they’re always very clean and no violence or death or anything like that but this movie really felt real in that sort of way when it came to the armadillo or even Rango just eating one of the dragonflies that were going by. It was oddly refreshing in that way. Rango was a very fun character to watch, a very basic evolution but that’s not always unsatisfying if done right. A fish out of water story done perfectly in my opinion. Beans wasn’t a very developed character though, wish there was more there. I did love the country bumpkins at times because they brought a lot of color to the whole vibe of the movie. Overall, a super fun watch. Great party movie. Very rewatchable. Johnny Depp with an American accent is scary.

If you've never seen "Oshi no Ko", it's a very well animated, very badly written anime that tricks viewers into thinking it's good because it's so pretty. Being pretty does not make up for the bad writing. Being pretty is easy. "Rango" is ultimately a very simple and harmless children's film. Narratively it's nothing impressive. Some parts even are arguably just bad. Depp's improv is much less charming these days than it was 15 years ago, and it's got probably the worst example of the dreaded "liar revealed" trope in recent memory. But it is also one of the most artistically creative and visually impressive pieces of animation ever put to screen. It's more than just "pretty". In fact most of the film is ugly as all hell, but intentionally. Animation just being pretty doesn't excuse flawed writing, but the level of artistic talent and creativity put into this film is different from "pretty"

A decently good movie. The cinematography is good, and the animation looks pretty good. The length is short, which is a good thing. The plot is decent, but it's not special or clever in any way. Animated films usually don't get to me on a personal level, and this one is no exception and It's also filled with some very dumb moments. The second half is surprisingly slightly better than the first half. The final battle is good and the ending is also good. Overall, this film has some very good moments that I think could have worked much better as a live-action film but on the other hand that couldn't have worked on Live action so it probably should have balanced that out in a better way. If it was somehow more live-action and less dumb, it probably could have gotten a higher score. 7.4/10

Rango was my favorite Movie for a few years as a child. I just rewatched it and I get why. It’s very different from standard children movies. It has characters wich are not just superficial. I mean rangos Charakter Development throughout the movie is very good and understandable. He is the biggest Larper in the beginning wich is very fun to watch as well as him needing to prove himself in the end. The movie also touches on themes other kids movies leave out because they can be too dark like death, guns, Alkohol and even a bit of politics wich is actually not as bad as they first sound and as a child I did not get traumatised after watching it or other stuff parents or so would expect. Also these themes do not hurt the movie it’s still a very fun kids movie wich adults can really enjoy too. I think the artstyle, theme and story of the movie was bold as well as different and that really paid off, because it set it apart from other films primarily targeted at children I watched when I was younger.

Rango is a really fun and unique film. It has a great protagonist, a distinct Wild West theme and presentation, and it’s hilarious. Rango is an awesome character with very strong character development. He starts as a chameleon in a tank, gets thrown in the middle of no where, fakes it til he makes it, becomes sheriff and starts proving it through moments such as standing up to Rattlesnake Jake and protecting Dirt. He ends up becoming a symbol of hope and a true hero for Dirt. The Wild West theme and the presentation of this film are amazing. The pretty sunsets and night skies, the desert setting, a great score, the sounds such as the clock hitting high noon on a Wednesday or guns reloading, and the town of Dirt give it a distinct feel. The Mariachi owls as narrators and occasionally breaking the fourth wall also added on to its feel. Rango is a really fun film with a great protagonist who goes from zero to hero. Combine that with comedy and a beautiful yet distinct Wild West presentation makes this a great watch. 8/10

Rango cuenta la historia no solo de un don nadie, sino de un mentiroso. Rango en un principio miente ya que anhela ser alguien digno de admiración como en sus historias, pero comprende que las palabras no significan nada sin acciones. Su evolución se siente realista, no vemos directamente los cambios pero sabemos que algo dentro de él esta cambiando. Es visualmente preciosa y aunque el estilo no es para todo el mundo no se puede negar que hay ciertos momentos en la película en los que es un deleite para la vista. La serpiente no es el villano final, era la última prueba en la que él se debía enfrentar para poder darle significado a ese nombre. Aparte de que quien le de la voz a Rango sea Johnny depp es un puntazo jeje🥹

Deconstruye la típica trama del viaje del héroe con un protagonista carismático que debe volverse más fuerte para encontrar su propio camino. Aparte como dato está es la primera película que vi en el cine en toda mi vida, con tan solo tres años, y me ha encantado poder revivirla ahora de mayor.

“No man can walk out on his own story.” Rango is a love letter to the classic westerns of the 20th century while simultaneously being one of the greatest westerns of the 21st century. It somehow manages to follow the classic western blueprint step by step while checking off every single trope along the way, and yet there is nothing else like it. I adore Rango. The team behind this project were very clearly firing on all cylinders. The script is sharp, the plot is tight, the visuals are incredible and the voice cast is perfect. It’s just a start to finish treat of a film. There are some truly inspiring scenes in this movie. There are plenty of gags and fun throughout, but there are also several moments where it gets incredibly thoughtful, philosophical and emotional. It has to be one of my favorite animated movies at this point. Every time I revisit it I walk away with a stronger love and appreciation for it. The design for Rattlesnake Jake is S tier. The designs for every creature are incredible but the scene when Rattlesnake Jake shows up is genuinely intense.

La vi hace mucho tiempo de niño, al inicio no me parecía la gran cosa, solo veía bichos feos y una lagartija vaquera. Al crecer, por los azares del destino, la quise ver. No recuerdo el cómo ni el porqué. Ahora Rango, una película que para mí se ha ganado un lugar preciado en mi corazón. El personaje es un cobarde con aires de grandeza, quien habla mucho y actúa poco. Ha fingido ser más fuerte o seguro de lo que realmente es; pero aun así, acepta su destino. Un hombre (lagartija, creo) que está dispuesto a entregarse al espectáculo de la vida y ser el personaje principal de su propio destino. Rango empieza actuando en un terrario y termina actuando en el mundo real, hasta que la actuación se vuelve su realidad. Para mí, creo que de eso se trata un poco la vida: fingir lo que queremos ser para reconfortarnos un poco y darnos esos pequeños empujones que necesitamos en el camino. No puede evitar verme reflejado; es cine absoluto.

Este es la mejor película del viejo oeste sin duda. Es una película que representa todo lo contrario a una peli del viejo oeste tradicional y casi pareciera que se burla del género, es una película absurda, ridícula, tonta... (en el buen sentido) con un "héroe" atroz. Rango es un "héroe" torpe, tonto, confiado, embustero, ignorante con muy buena labia y sabe manejar increíblemente a las personas y eso más una serie de puras casualidades lo llevan a ser el nuevo héroe de un pueblo perdido. Pero en el fondo Rango siente una profunda soledad, por ello no se quiere alejar de sus nuevos amigos y alargará su enbuste hasta que finalmente se tenga que enfrentar a el. Es gracioso que el perfil del que se enamora (que es todo lo contrario a Rango) si cumple todas las características de un heroe, Aba (o como se escriba), una mujer-bicho que no le teme a nada. Luego también quisiera destacar la preciosa animación de la película, es flipante. También es una peli que me ha resultado muy graciosa (en mi opinión no la pondría para todos los públicos) mi escena favorita sin duda la de Rango con falda y el cucharas JAJAJAJA.
